How to use Lemon Network Solutions

For owners and managers of offices, clinics, schools, warehouses and shops who need a network designed, installed or managed, and for technicians learning UniFi.

Open Lemon Network Solutions ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Click Plan your project in the site header.

2

Describe the site: type, area, floors, users, city, timeline and budget.

3

Select the systems you need: internet and firewall, WiFi, cameras, door access, phones, audio-video, cabling, managed services.

4

Review the estimate built from real products, list prices and labor.

5

Reserve the consultation and send your floor plans. The project book follows.

02

Features

01

Planner

Three steps: site, needs, reservation. The estimate lists each product with photo and list price, plus labor, as a range.

STEPS

  1. Enter the site details
  2. Select the systems you need
  3. Reserve, or email the estimate to yourself
02

Project book

Ten pages: investment, summary, requirements, network design and port map, WiFi coverage, cameras and doors, rack and cabling, bill of materials, timeline, support and acceptance.

STEPS

  1. Open the sample on the planner page
  2. Page 2 gives the total and the terms
  3. Page 10 is the acceptance signature
03

Services and case studies

Managed IT, switching, WiFi, cameras, VoIP, cabling and AV, with 16 case studies that include drawings and bills of materials.

STEPS

  1. Read the case study closest to your site
  2. Note the equipment used
  3. Ask for the same design for your site
04

Academy, shop and books

39 UniFi lessons, the full catalogue with one page per product, and two technical books with free sample chapters.

STEPS

  1. Learn the basics in the Academy
  2. Look up specifications in the Shop
  3. Read a sample chapter
03Tips
  • Have a floor plan ready; the design is drawn on it.
  • The consultation fee is credited if you book the project within 30 days.
  • Plan installation and managed services together.
04FAQ
Where do you install?

Write with your city; the planner accepts any site.

Do you only install UniFi?

The planner and the books are based on UniFi. Other brands are quoted on request.

How long does a project take?

The sample book shows six weeks from deposit to handover for a mid-size office.

Is there a phone number?

No. Email and the contact form are answered within one business day.
